PLAN-064.title: Test Coverage: Critical Path Hardening
PLAN-064.goal: Pre-launch audit identified systemic test coverage gaps across the Go backend, frontend composables, and GitHub Action. The core execution engine, primary frontend mutation surfaces, MCP state-machine transitions, and the CLI transport layer all have zero isolation coverage despite running on every user-visible flow. This plan addresses those gaps in priority order: critical zero-coverage production paths first, then medium-risk edge cases.
